headline: DET @ NYM matchup research
quickWriteup: The current model score is DET 3.46 at NYM 3.80, with a projected total of 7.26. Movement read: The side movement strengthened toward NYM: DET moved -0.87 runs while NYM moved -0.29, changing the projected margin by -0.58 runs. The projected total fell -1.16, which points to a lower-run game script than the earliest saved read. Pitching context: Christian Scott has the better recent run-prevention profile in the available start logs at 1.3 ER over the last 3 starts. Batter research is strongest for Riley Greene, Francisco Alvarez, Carson Benge, based on recent hit rates, matching location/opponent samples, or similar-game production. The cold/risk list flags MJ Melendez, Jahmai Jones because the recent hit profile or strikeout trend is weaker than the projection alone would show.
